name: The Loom Keeper
notes: Yellow Guardian (Jay picked it and OK'd docs/yellow-guardian-loom-keeper.md, Nov 25). Darkness over the tailor's loom (Story of the Light v2: a Guardian is never a person). Three parts: Spool Drop (COUNTER), Thread Line (a dash-only thread wall to wall through the player, 'area': 'line'), Big Cloth (a dash-only cloth over the player's side of the room, 'area': 'cloth', reaching areaRadius past the player, so one Dash always clears it, the GUARD-SCALE-01 rule). Only one move at a time and no helpers, a step below the Hearth Cook. Starting numbers between the Floor Keeper (495) and the Hearth Cook (549); the balance test tunes them. Drawn as a code stand-in until the Blender model is OK'd; the coat tears at a third of its health.

attacks.name: spool drop
attacks.tell: It lifts the spool high; a red circle under the hero.

attacks.name: thread line
attacks.tell: A striped thread wall to wall through the hero, '!!' and a twang.

attacks.name: crossing threads
attacks.tell: Threads across, then up and down, one at a time.

attacks.name: big cloth
attacks.tell: A dark cloth over the hero's side of the room; its edge glows for 1.5 seconds.

phases.tell: It lifts the spool; red circle.
phases.senseiLine: The spool goes up first. Ready.

phases.tell: A striped thread across the room.
The coat tears; the cloth's edge glows.
phases.senseiLine: Watch the glowing edge. Stay bright.

senseiAtDoor: Someone used to sew warm things here.
senseiAfterWin: Warm things are made to be shared.

lines.intro: Someone used to sew warm things here.
lines.freed: Take a blanket. Someone out there's cold.
lines.freedBy: Miss Ada, the tailor, in town (draft name)
lines.senseiAfter: Warm things are made to be shared.

description: The Loom Keeper drops its spool, pulls threads across the room, then slides a big dark cloth over your side.

bestiary.tip: Spool, then threads, then the big cloth.

lore.yellow: Darkness settled on the tailor's loom and took her shape. It weaves grey cloth that warms no one.
